mappings.note: Translation v1 describes Jonathan going to the city (וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלַךְ וִיהֹונָתָן בָּא הָעִיר׃). This content is completely absent from the provided OSMAIN text, which begins immediately with David arriving at Nob.
Matches OSMAIN v1: 'David kom til Nob... Hvorfor er du alene...' (David came to Nob... Why are you alone...).

Translation v1-3 covers David's speech about the king's secret mission. OSMAIN v2 contains this text but is cut off mid-sentence ('...sendt til et'). Translation v3 continues with 'Og nå, hva har du for hånden...', which corresponds to the start of OSMAIN v3 in content, but the translation splits David's speech across two verses (v2 and v3) while OSMAIN has it split differently or truncated. Specifically, Translation v3 starts with the request for bread ('Hva har du for hånden? Gi meg fem brød'), which is the start of OSMAIN v3. However, looking closely at the Hebrew structure vs Norwegian: The Hebrew v3 ends with '...sendte jeg guttene dine til...' (cut off). The Norwegian v2 cuts off similarly. The request for bread ('Og nå...') starts in Norwegian v3. So Translation v3 corresponds to the start of OSMAIN v3.
Matches OSMAIN v3: 'Og nå, hva har du for hånden? Gi meg fem brød...' (And now, what do you have... Give me five loaves...).

Matches OSMAIN v4: 'Presten svarte David... bare hellig brød – hvis tjenerne i det minste har holdt seg borte fra kvinner.' (The priest answered... only holy bread - if the servants have kept away from women).
Matches OSMAIN v5: 'David svarte presten... Ja, kvinner har vært holdt borte fra oss...' (David answered the priest... Yes, women have been kept away from us...).
Matches OSMAIN v6: 'Da ga presten ham det hellige brødet...' (Then the priest gave him the holy bread...).
Matches OSMAIN v7: 'Den dagen var en av Sauls tjenere der...' (That day one of Saul's servants was there...).
Matches OSMAIN v8: 'David sa til Akimelek: Har du ikke et spyd eller et sverd...' (David said to Ahimelech: Do you not have a spear or sword...).
Matches OSMAIN v9: 'Presten svarte: Sverdet til filisteren Goliat...' (The priest answered: The sword of the Philistine Goliath...).
Matches OSMAIN v10: 'David brøt opp og flyktet den dagen fra Saul. Han kom til Akisj...' (David set out and fled that day from Saul. He came to Achish...).
Matches OSMAIN v11: 'Akisjs tjenere sa til ham: Er ikke dette David...' (Achish's servants said to him: Is this not David...).
Matches OSMAIN v12: 'David la seg disse ordene på sinne og ble svært redd...' (David took these words to heart and was very afraid...).
Matches OSMAIN v13: 'Han forstilte seg for øynene deres og oppførte seg som en gal mann...' (He changed his behavior before their eyes and acted like a madman...).
Matches OSMAIN v14: 'Da sa Akisj til tjenerne sine: Dere ser at mannen er gal...' (Then Achish said to his servants: You see the man is mad...).
Matches OSMAIN v15: 'Mangler jeg gale mennesker, siden dere har brakt denne hit...' (Do I lack madmen that you have brought this one here...).

extraContent.description: The verse 'וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלַךְ וִיהֹונָתָן בָּא הָעִיר׃' (Then Jonathan arose and went into the city) is present in the translation but has no corresponding text in the provided OSMAIN verses. The OSMAIN text starts directly with David's arrival at Nob.
